_predictions: DZM on every 1st of the month from 1836.2.1 (59 polls); tracked well under scanned (a few hundred to ~2,000 of ~8,000 producing buildings), proving occupancy filters; DZ lines in 1837-1840 at a rate near F260's quarterly vanilla (1,000 drops over 1836-1921, so a few dozen here), each matched by a save-side drop of the same size, private counts equal to the saves' private levels; IsAutoDownsizing = yes on nearly every DZX; no zzz_v3tb error.
